newsitem.title: SPAIN: Argentaria sees '96 profit of 85 bln pta.
newsitem.headline: Argentaria sees '96 profit of 85 bln pta.

text.p: Argentaria said on Wednesday it expected 1996 gross profit of 85 billion pesetas.
Argentaria's chairman Francisco Gonzalez told a news conference this profit compared with an 84.94 billion peseta gross profit made in 1995.
He said 42 billion pesetas of the company's 1996 profit would be used to cut the average cost of its liabilities to 6.49 percent to 9.79 percent.
"In some cases we will depreciate it and in others we will refinance at market rates," Gonzalez said.
He added that the reduction in liabilities would help increase the net interest income in coming years by 12 or 13 billion pesetas per year.
